title: UiKit prop statement
description: What one of this component's own properties states and why nothing checks it further - the retired `untyped` catch-all's `about: prop` category, keyed on the property itself instead of naming it inside a flat list. Required for every prop the schema does not state in full (partly typed, or description-only) and forbidden for one it states completely: a claim about a fully typed prop would be a claim about a different contract, the same pairing the old list was checked against, now over the overlay's `props` map and the property it is a key of.

states.description: What the property actually holds, in the words a reader needs before the schema's own partial shape misleads them - an array of the caller's own generic parameter, a live object, a function.

because.description: Why nothing checks it further: no JSON Schema shape for a generic, a live object, a function, or a type this contract has no business re-typing.
